create_relation_ace_reader: create a RelationACEReader instance to read relation labels from preprocessed ACE dataset files
read_relation_ace_dataset: read relation labels from an ACE dataset file path and yield NLP instances with token and relation fields
convert_tokens_to_instance: convert a list of Token objects and relation labels into an AllenNLP Instance with TextField and SequenceLabelField
iterate_ace_sentences: iterate over ACE sentences from a directory of CoNLL-format files using the ACE reader utility
register_dataset_reader: register RelationACEReader as a 'relation_ace' dataset reader via AllenNLP's DatasetReader decorator
